purpose: Finds a vault's profile photo and loads it, and makes the vault's own card when it has none.
namedChanges: host first argument: `discoverVaultProfilePhoto`, `writeCachedPhotoRef` and `clearCachedPhotoRef` take `host: VaultProfilePhotoHost`; `photoReadKeys()` (GilbApp `src/lib/base/photoTerm.ts:37`) is `host.photoReadKeys()`; `knownVaultPicture.note(vaultId, has)` (`src/lib/knownFact.ts`) is `host.noteVaultPicture?.(vaultId, has)`, optional, absent means nothing is noted; the calls of the two helpers pass `host`.

a module-load origin becomes a function over the setting: `BASE_ORIGIN` is `baseOrigin()` of `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-base-origin` in `discoverVaultProfilePhoto` (the published-card URL) and in `loadPhotoObjectUrl` (`new URL(photoRef, baseOrigin())`).

The imports are the units': `readRecord` and, in `selfCardRecord.ts`, `toWireFacts`, `throwForCreateStatus`, `idFromResourceUrl`, `RecordCreateFacts`, `WriteSource` from `lws-records` (0.4.0); `downloadFile` from `file-download-outcome`; `dpopReadAuth`, `dpopWriteAuth` from `lws-session-bridge`; `typeUriForVaultNamespace` from `record-types`; `photoRefFromFacts` from `photo-term`; `atVaultOrigin`, `selfCardIdForVault`, `vaultSegmentOf`, `vaultOriginOf` from `vault-origin-rule`; `baseOrigin` from `base-origin`; and this unit's own `./gilbPhotoRef`, `./selfCardRecord`, `./selfCardMade`, `./vaultProfilePhotoHost` (in the source: `./config`, `./records`, `./files`, `./dpop`, `./recordTypes`, `gilb-photo`, `../knownFact`, `./photoTerm`, `./selfCardMade`).
`LWS_VAULT_SELFCARD_URL` (GilbApp `src/lib/base/config.ts:518`) is an inline named copy in `selfCardRecord.ts`: `${vaultOriginOf(vaultId)}/lws/vault/${encodeURIComponent(vaultId)}/selfcard`.

`entityIdTail` and `fileIdFromPhotoRef` are the private package `gilb-photo`'s, copied by script into `src/gilbPhotoRef.ts` (repository commit bf56ec7, `src/photoRef.ts` lines 17-31 and 33-77, last changed by commit 8b5c74d8570e78f0686258164b9f4f4f8b6a595a), not the `photo-ref` unit's: on a malformed percent-encoding they throw where `photo-ref` answers null or an empty string (a false friend, in the README).

Comments that name a host, a cycle, a ticket, an agent or a person are reworded, and `BASE_ORIGIN` in a comment reads `baseOrigin()`; no code changed. The header comment of `selfCardMade.ts` is a new, shorter one.
